ingredientSections.heading: Shrimp Ceviche
items: ¼ Cup Lime Juice (juice from 1-2 limes)
½ Cup Red Onion, finely diced
1 Serrano Chilli, ribs & seeds removed, minced

methodSections.heading: Shrimp Ceviche
steps: In a large saucepan, bring 3 to 4 litres of water to the boil, add the salt.
Cook the shrimp for between 1 and 2 minutes, depending on size of shrimp. Do not overcook as they will turn rubbery.
Remove shrimp with a slotted spoon and place into a bowl of ice water to stop the cooking. Reserve the cooking liquid.
Cut each piece of shrimp in half or into smaller pieces. Place in a glass or ceramic bowl and mix in the lime and orange juice. Season with salt and pepper, cover and refrigerate for a half an hour.
Stir in the chopped onion, tomatoes and serrano chile. Add the mustard, beer, olive oil and half a cup of the cooking liquid.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Just before serving top with the cilantro and avocado.
If you find the ceviche a little too acidic, drain out some of the juices after the marinating and add a little more cooking liquid and/or avocado.
